spec.assertion: Trigger identity: the header is a counted ACTIVATION clause, so the buff must first apply strictly after frame 0 and re-apply on a counter, not sit live from t=0. Fails under the nearest-wrong `passive` model (asserted to differ in totals). ⚑ The count is on being ATTACKED — the sim has no incoming-damage channel (immortal boss, no ally HP pool), so the real activation cadence is NOT derivable from the kit text; any concrete engine trigger (hitCount on own hits, or a fixed interval) is an INVENTED cadence and must ship flagged. The test pins only the observable structure (not-from-frame-0, finite window), never a cadence number.

Scope: the prose says "Multiplier", which is `chargeDamageMultPct` (scales by BASE charge damage), not the additive `chargeDamagePct` points bucket. Asserts the emitted buffApply carries stat chargeDamageMultPct at raw value 9.59; fails under the nearest-wrong chargeDamagePct patch, which emits the other stat and shifts totals.
Target set: >1 distinct targetSlug on the chargeDamageMultPct applies, including admi herself. Fails under the nearest-wrong self-only patch, which collapses to exactly 1 target.

Duration semantics: seconds, not rounds. Asserts expiresFrame is finite (not permanent) and durationShots is absent (a `for N round(s)` model would set it). No buffRemove is asserted — the engine emits none on natural lapse.

it.skip. Ally-side incoming-damage reduction has no representable payload: the sim models no ally HP pool and the scope-lock boss deals no damage. The schema's `damageTakenPct` is explicitly the BOSS debuff (positive = boss takes more), so encoding this line there is a sign error that would hand the team free damage. Positive guard asserted live: NO damageTakenPct buffApply exists anywhere in the run, including the boss-held (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) channel. Belongs verbatim in `unmodeled.skill2`.

it.skip. The correct target primitive is alliesTopAtk{count:2, byFinalAtk:true} — the prose says "final ATK" literally, which is the documented trigger for byFinalAtk (live effectiveAtk ranking) over static ranking. Unassertable while the payload it would carry is unrepresentable; re-enable if an ally-scoped damage-taken stat ever lands.

Two claims. (a) stat/magnitude: reloadSpeedPct at raw 50.91, finite expiresFrame, no durationShots. (b) NON-INERTNESS: reload speed gates shots fired, so stripping the effect must strictly LOWER total team damage — asserted against a patched run with the reloadSpeedPct effect removed. This is the direct guard against the recurring "reload is defensive, skip it" failure mode.

Scope: critDamagePct (scales crit magnitude), NOT critRatePct (changes crit frequency) and not the normal-attack-scoped critRateNormalPct. Asserts raw value 28.34; fails under the nearest-wrong critRatePct patch (no critDamagePct events + totals differ).
Target set: both burst stats reach >1 distinct targetSlug including admi. Fails under the nearest-wrong self-only patch (crit-damage target set collapses to 1, totals differ).

Trigger identity: the lines sit in admi's OWN burst slot with no "entering Full Burst" clause, so they key to her burstCast, not fullBurstEnter. Asserts the number of distinct application windows never exceeds admi's own burstCast count — over-firing (the fullBurstEnter over-credit failure mode) breaks it. admi is Burst II, so in a multi-B2 team the two triggers would diverge.

spec.kitLine: inertness — no ATK, no rider damage
spec.assertion: Negative space: the kit grants no ATK of any flavour (atkPct / casterAtkPct / highestAllyAtkPct / atkOfMaxHpPct all assert zero applies) and carries no flatDamage/dot/storedHit line, so all of admi's damage is her own weapon. Catches an over-modeled override that invents a support ATK buff or a rider proc.

fixtures: controlComp('admi', true) for every run — admi is Burst II, so the control's liter(B1)/crown(B2)/carry(B3)/helm(B3) frame is what lets a burst chain complete and admi actually cast; a lone unit makes zero Full Bursts and every burst assertion would be vacuous. Fixed-B3 flag left true: helm's S1 is critRateNormalPct (normal-attack-scoped crit RATE), which cannot alias admi's crit DAMAGE line, and none of the fixed slots grant chargeDamageMultPct or reloadSpeedPct — so no fixture buff confounds the three stats under test. Deterministic (no seed) so base vs counterfactual totals are byte-comparable. Six hoisted runs total (base + 5 counterfactuals: wrong charge stat, wrong charge target, wrong charge trigger, wrong crit stat, wrong burst target, reload stripped = 7), well under the ~20-run ceiling.
gaps: skill2 'Damage Taken ▼ 28.65% for 10 sec' — it.skip: no ally-side incoming-damage channel exists (no ally HP pool, boss deals no damage at scope lock) and the schema's damageTakenPct is the BOSS debuff with inverted sign; unrepresentable, belongs in unmodeled.skill2. A live positive assertion guards that it was NOT mis-encoded as a boss debuff.

skill2 'Affects 2 allies with the highest final ATK' — it.skip: alliesTopAtk{count:2, byFinalAtk:true} is the correct primitive but has no representable payload to attach, so the target-set choice is unobservable.

skill1 activation cadence — ⛑ FLAGGED, not asserted: 'when attacked 20 time(s)' counts INCOMING attacks, which the sim does not model at all. No engine trigger faithfully represents it; whatever the override picks (hitCount on own hits, or an interval) is an invented cadence outside the kit's input domain and must ship flagged with an estimate + recipe. The test therefore pins only structure (first apply after frame 0, finite 20s window, all-allies, correct stat) and deliberately asserts NO firing count or interval — asserting one would enshrine a guess.
